parsed.internal_thinking: Sean is offering 2 Wheat for 1 Ore. I currently have 1 Ore and 2 Wheat. Looking at the game state, Sean has 4 Wheat and 1 Ore in hand. If I give him this Ore, he will have 2 Ore and 2 Wheat (after the trade), which doesn't immediately give him a city, but he is clearly fishing for Ore to upgrade his settlements (Node 12 or 44). Hadar has explicitly warned me not to trade him Ore, and given our shared interest in keeping him from running away, accepting this trade would damage my relationship with her and potentially hand Sean the win (since we are playing to only 5 VP). I'll reject to keep the pressure on him and maintain the alliance with Hadar.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Sean's 2:1 Wheat for Ore trade. He's desperate for Ore to build a city. Keep holding the Ore for my own city or a better 3-way deal with Hadar later.
